name: pr_review
description: GhostBuster PR Review — When a PR is opened, automatically run MutaCI to find behavioral gaps, classify severity via Laya AI, and generate targeted tests.

steps.name: Scope changed files
steps.description: Identify which TypeScript files changed in the PR diff.

steps.name: Laya severity triage
steps.description: Laya AI scores each surviving mutant (1-10). Mutants scoring ≥7 are escalated.

steps.name: Generate targeted tests (Claude)
steps.description: Claude generates one test per surviving mutant with severity ≥ 4.

steps.name: Post PR comment
steps.description: Post a structured comment on the PR with the MutaCI report and links to generated tests.
